title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Reports 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today reported financial and operating results for the fourth quarter and full year ended December 31, 2025 and provided initial guidance for 2026. For the three months ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company reported Net Income of $2.7 million, or $0.03 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $9.8 million, or $0.13 per diluted share, respectively. For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company reported Net Income of $111.4 million, or $1.42 per diluted share, compared to Net Income of $13.7 million, or $0.19 per diluted share, respectively.
